tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The tenderer shall comply with all the provisions under Karnataka Minimum Wages Act., Labor Laws such as EPF, ESI and payment of Wages etc. and provide the necessary proof of its compliance every month together with the bill. In case the tenderer fails to provide such proof of payments made to the personnel until 25th of the month in which it is due and such default occurs for more than 3months in continuous period of contract, the same will be considered as Breach of Contract. In that case action will be initiated by the KPTCL for short closer of contract and other actions as per Corporate norms including forfeiting of Security deposit
its Notwithstanding the above, if it is found that the performance vis a vis works awarded to the Bidder by KPTCL is not satisfactory, KPTCL will be at liberty to cancel the award.
The Bidder must not have been blacklisted by KPTCL or ESCOMS or other Electrical Utilities or Private Companies or Public Sector Companies or Banks

The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Bidder may result in rejection of bid

Notwithstanding anything stated above, the KPTCL reserves the right to assess the bidders capability to perform the work, should the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of the KPTCL

Bidder shall note that KPTCL may not award the work to successful bidder, if in opinion of KPTCL based on its experience, the firm may not perform well in assigned work and may delay in paying the statutory charges
Bidder shall submit only one tender in the same tendering process

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have at least one year experience as on the date of bid opening during 5years in manpower services of outsourced persons (DEO/Driver/ Attender/ Sweeper/etc.) to State/Central Government department /organization, public sector companies or KPTCL/ESCOM etc. Previous purchase order copies/ performance certificate issued by the Officer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent shall be uploaded

The tenderer shall upload the performance certificates for minimum of 2 nos of outsourced persons, issued by head of the State/Central Government department /organization, public sector companies or KPTCL/ ESCOM etc. not below the rank of EEE or equivalent division head. (The no of services provided is to be clearly mentioned in the certificate otherwise it will not considered during the bid evaluation.)
The tenderer shall be an individual proprietorship firm or partnership firm or company registered under Indian Companies Act. Necessary registration certificate shall be uploaded

The tenderer should be a reputed manpower providing agency having valid registration certificate issued by Department of Labor. Gok for providing manpower services. Documentary proof in the form of certificate of registration issued by GoK is to be uploaded

The tenderer shall upload details regarding a) GST, b) Labour Registration Certificate, c) ESI if not applicable a self-declaration, d) EPF and e) PAN issued by the respective competent authorities of the concerned department

The tenderer shall upload audited annual financial statements with due signature of auditor & owner/director/proprietor duly mentioning the UDIN no., such as Profit & Loss statement, Balance sheets for the years 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
The tenderer shall upload certificate from Chartered Accountants with UDIN for split details of financial turnover and GST

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should have achieved in at least two financial years in the last five years an average annual financial turnover not less than amount put to tender

The tenderer shall upload the Liquid Assets and/or availability of credit facilities of not less than Amount as that of Amount put to tender (Credit lines/ letter of credit/certificates from banks) for meeting the fund requirement etc. are to be submitted in prescribed format ANNEXURE-III on the bank letter head, and scanned copy (in colour) of the original to be uploaded
